findings.description: [Image 00 | t=4.25s | Settled Act 1: ProtoType] Strong settled hierarchy: ProtoType dominates center with a crisp thin blue accent border, framed cleanly by 3 dimmed corner sub cards (TL Telecaster, BL Blue graphic, TR Two-char anime). 2x2 dock alignment is neat, but Dock TL (FoldLayers) is nearly pure black and Dock TR (dark editor UI) is very dark — at ~350px width Dock TL reads almost like an empty cutout despite the lifted rim. Subtle rectangular WebP quantization ghosting is visible on the dark canvas near card corners.

[Image 01 | t=5.50s | Transition Act 1->2] Protagonist hand-off reads cleanly and causally: incoming Telecaster B-Boy expands from TL with the blue accent border and top z-order while outgoing ProtoType shrinks into TR with no collision. However, inside the dock only 2 thumbnails remain and the teal MV sits awkwardly mid-height along the right edge (unaligned between row 1 and row 2), while the bottom-left corner has noticeable empty dark dead space and faint rectangular WebP ghost trails on the dark background.

[Image 02 | t=6.00s | Settled Act 2: Telecaster B-Boy] Excellent settled composition. High-contrast yellow/red protagonist dominates center with crisp blue accent tracking and strong readability at ~350px. All 3 corner subs (TL FoldLayers, TR ProtoType, BL dark editor UI) are cleanly tucked behind the main card with legible rims, and the 2x2 dock is neatly filled and aligned with all 4 thumbnails readable.

[Image 03 | t=6.50s | Settled Act 2: Telecaster B-Boy] Confirms smooth live playback (score 492024->504294, combo 81->83, updated character pose and 'Perfect' graphic, animated dock thumbnails) with no frozen or stretched frames. Visual hierarchy, accent border, and 2x2 dock neatness remain rock-solid.

[Image 04 | t=10.00s | Transition Act 2->3] Causal read is clear as FoldLayers ('Just your timeline.') emerges from TL behind receding Telecaster B-Boy (still holding the blue border and top z-order). However, the undocking cat-ear girl MV is squeezed into a narrow clipped sliver in the tight gap between Telecaster's bottom-right edge and the dock's left edge, reading more like accidental clipping than intentional depth. Dock TR and BL are empty, and the entire bottom-left quadrant is empty dark dead space.

[Image 05 | t=10.75s | Transition Act 2->3] Main hand-off succeeds cleanly: FoldLayers owns center with the blue accent border and top z-order, and all 3 corner subs (TL cat-ear girl, TR Telecaster, BL teal MV) are virtually settled. Yet the dock lags behind: its entire right column is still empty, and inbound Dock TL (ProtoType) rides high right against the top border of the dock plate rather than seated cleanly inside its slot.

[Image 06 | t=11.25s | Settled Act 3: FoldLayers] Clean settled frame with strong hierarchy and crisp blue accent border. While the After Effects UI is dense at ~350px, the bold white kinetic text ('But now') and bright blue viewport preserve readability. Corner subs (TL cat-ear girl, TR Telecaster, BL teal MV) are well balanced and the 2x2 dock is fully populated and aligned (though dark TL/TR thumbnails lose interior detail at small scale).

[Image 07 | t=15.75s | Transition Act 3->4] Weakest transition frame. Inbound Telecaster B-Boy (heading from TR into the dock) drops BEHIND the dock plate while still oversized (~85px wide), getting sliced off horizontally by the plate's top-left corner — this reads as an unintentional collision/clipping bug and sets up a z-order pop once it shrinks to ~64px to ride above. Simultaneously, teal MV and blue graphic cluster side-by-side right beneath FoldLayers' bottom edge while top-right and bottom-left corners sit as empty voids, and the dock's bottom row is empty.

[Image 08 | t=16.25s | Settling Act 4: Cat-ear girl MV] Protagonist transfer is strong: Cat-ear girl MV is centered with high contrast, crisp blue accent border, and excellent ~350px readability. However, corner sub footage hurts polish: TL (two-char work) shows a flat, featureless medium-grey frame that reads like a blank placeholder, and TR (FoldLayers) is nearly black with awkwardly cropped partial text ('lling. Start creating.'). Dock BR is still empty (3/4 filled) just 0.25s before the 16.5s boundary.

[Image 09 | t=21.25s | Early Transition Act 4->5] Cat-ear girl MV holds center and blue border while BL blue graphic begins expanding and TR FoldLayers is readable. However, the entire top-left quadrant is completely empty dark void (the TL sub has already vanished/gone invisible), creating a noticeably lopsided layout. At bottom-right, the undocking teal MV peeks out from behind the dock's left edge as a sharp chopped slice between the main card and dock, and Dock BR is empty.

[Image 10 | t=21.75s | Mid-Transition Act 4->5] Primary hand-off reads causally (blue graphic expands from BL under receding Cat-ear girl MV, which still holds the blue accent border and top z-order, while FoldLayers shrinks cleanly above the dock). However, the teal MV is trapped as a tiny cropped sliver under the intersection of the two large cards, roughly a third of the canvas (the entire top-left quadrant) is empty dark dead space with faint WebP rectangular ghosting, and the dock is down to 2 populated slots.

[Image 11 | t=22.25s | Settling Act 5: Blue graphic '夜'] Strong protagonist hand-off: cobalt-and-white '夜' graphic dominates center with crisp blue accent border and standout readability at ~350px; all 3 corner subs (TL ProtoType, TR Cat-ear girl, BL teal MV) are in place. However, even past the 22.0s act boundary, inbound FoldLayers visibly overhangs/protrudes past the top rim of the dock plate instead of seating inside Dock TL, and Dock BR remains completely empty (3/4 populated).

verdict.summary: Verdict: ACCEPT WITH FIXES (request-changes). Settled acts (00, 02, 03, 06) and primary protagonist hand-offs show strong visual hierarchy, clean blue accent border tracking, smooth non-frozen playback, and solid readability at ~350px. However, rev 7's dock-riding threshold and transition timing still produce concrete visual blemishes around the dock plate and corner voids during act boundaries. Top 3 fixes by impact: (1) Fix inbound dock trajectories, pre-plate shrink timing, and settle synchronization — shrink park-bound cards to thumbnail size (~64px) BEFORE they reach the dock plate's bounding box so cards like Telecaster in Image 07 don't get sliced off behind the plate's top edge, eliminate the Dock TL top-rim overhang seen in Images 05 and 11, and finish seating all 4 dock slots (including Dock BR in Images 08/11) in sync with the act boundary. (2) Clean up mid-transition undocking slivers and corner dead space — gently fade/dim undocking cards while passing behind the dock's left edge (Images 04, 09) and tuck non-dock travellers cleanly so they don't wedge as tiny slivers under main cards (Images 07, 10), and keep the outgoing TL card visible slightly longer or ease incoming subs earlier in Act 4->5 (Images 09, 10) to avoid emptying the entire top-left quadrant. (3) Offset dead-black/flat-grey source clip moments and reduce WebP dark-canvas ghosting — shift clip start offsets by ~0.5-1.5s to avoid the near-black Dock TL frame in Image 00 and flat-grey TL / black cropped-text TR frames in Image 08, and tune WebP quantization/keyframe settings to remove faint rectangular ghost trails on the dark background (Images 00, 01, 04, 10).
